title: Loading UI with Next.js 13 and React Suspense
description:
Next.js 13 introduced a new file convention, loading.js, to help you create meaningful Loading UI with React Suspense. Watch Sam Selikoff show a demo in three minutes. Try Vercel today: https://vercel.fyi/trypro

💻 Resources:
◆ Loading UI: https://beta.nextjs.org/docs/routing/loading-ui
◆ Rendering: Server and Client Components: https://beta.nextjs.org/docs/rendering/server-and-client-components

#vercel #nextjs
